get.description: Returns current network status including online player count.

Returns the list of players who voted for the network this month, with their
vote counts.

The list is refreshed periodically (every few hours) from the voting site.
The `fetchedAt` field is the Unix timestamp (milliseconds) of when the list was
last retrieved, so you can tell how fresh the data is.

503.description: Vote list has not been populated yet
